name_reason: Fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix + domain 'engine' (engine-level BIOS-tick frame pacer) + descriptor 'wait_one_bios_tick_last_seen' that accurately reflects purpose (the latched last-seen tick value for fd2_wait_one_bios_tick). No Ghidra address residue: there is no hex suffix equal to its own address 0x53a0c or any data address; 'one' is the semantic tick count (one tick), not an address fragment. Name also reflects the data semantics (a latched scalar tick value). Parallel sibling data_fd2_engine_wait_n_bios_ticks_last_seen uses the identical convention, confirming consistency.
purpose: Private 1-tick frame-pacer state latch for fd2_wait_one_bios_tick: caches the last-observed BIOS midnight tick so each call waits for the next tick (~55 ms / 18.2 Hz step).
logic_summary: fd2_wait_one_bios_tick reads the BIOS tick at 0:046C sign-extended (MOVSX EAX,word ptr [0x46C]) and busy-spins while the live tick equals this cached dword (CMP EAX,dword ptr [0x53A0C]); on exit it stores the freshly sign-extended tick back into this slot (MOV [0x53A0C],EAX). Because the full sign-extended 32-bit EAX is compared/stored as a dword, a low word of 0xFFFF caches as 0xFFFFFFFF. Only fd2_wait_one_bios_tick reads (0x13472) and writes (0x13482) it.
datatype: uint32 (Ghidra: undefined4, 4 bytes; semantically a sign-extended int32 tick value compared/stored as a dword)
element_semantics: Single scalar: the last-observed BIOS midnight-tick counter value (0:046C low word, sign-extended to 32 bits), used as a one-tick latch between consecutive frame-pacer calls.
notes: Mutable runtime state (game-side WRITE at 0x13482), zero-init BSS in .object2 -> is_const=false. The src comment block at input.c lines 705-715 is already precise, accurate, ASCII-clean, and matches the disassembly exactly (dword CMP/MOV at 0x53A0C, MOVSX from 0x46C, 0xFFFF->0xFFFFFFFF note); kept verbatim. Ghidra carries the equivalent accurate description in the data CodeUnit PRE_COMMENT (PLATE_COMMENT is null); content is consistent and non-contradictory with the refined understanding, so plate left untouched per refiner scope (field PRE->PLATE migration is a mechanism change not required by content correctness).
